description.narrative: The project aims at empowered rural communities in Eastern Bosnian and Herzegovina through established and strengthened women coalition and applied socio-economic empowerment interventions. Theproject is design to support rural women through improving economic opportunities, developing joint business models and access to markets, as well as promoting equal access to resources and property rights. 50 women and girls, primarily from rural areas excluded from the labor market, will be economically empowered by providing tailored vocational and business training, supporting the establishment of cooperative business models, and facilitating improved access to local and regional markets. By December 2028, at least 550 individuals affected by trauma and deteriorated mental health will complete multidisciplinary psychosocial support and rehabilitation programs provided by Vive Žene. At least 70% of beneficiaries will demonstrate measurable improvement in psychosocial wellbeing and social functioning (assessed through standardized evaluation tools), and 50% will report increased ability to reintegrate into family, community, or work.
